Resolves #20047

An undo that empties a popup no longer leaves its window on screen blank. `NativeVesselTransaction.replayWorkspaceReturn` embodied on undo and closed on redo only for the native-close return row (`returnPopupWorkspace`). Undoing a pop-out, or any row that emptied a popup, sent the pane home and kept the window open with nothing in it (56 DOM nodes, 0 tabs) until redo refilled it. Every undo and redo a popup participant receives now follows one rule, decided on its own post-cursor document. A replay that empties a bound popup closes its window after projection (the existing `closeWorkspaceWindow` fences). One that fills a popup without a window embodies it before projection. The return row's two branches are instances of that rule and behave as before. Only participants with a close policy are touched, so the root's window never is.

The trigger needs no native close: pop out a pane, then Undo, reproduces it on dev. The ticket's walk reached it through #20045: A's close went unrecorded, so the Undo reverted B's pop-out and emptied B. The two-popup arm reaches that state directly, so it keeps its meaning once #20053 records such a close.

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium e2e, red-first from a merge-base worktree; unit arms red-first) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2 are local runs; AC-4 is post-merge). See Test Evidence.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | `WorkstationUndoEmptiedPopupNL.spec.mjs`, "with two popups open, the undo closes only the popup it empties, within the bound; …": two pop-outs, then Undo through the toolbar button. The spec reads the time before the click and asserts that the emptied popup closes within 1000 ms of it; the other popup keeps its pane. Head: 5/5 green, 137–188 ms. Merge-base `e2f77dd0fb`: 2/2 red at "the emptied popup closes" (no close within 15 s). The ticket's literal sequence, with a close the worker records, is "after a native close returns its pane, …" (see Deltas). |
| AC-2 | Same two-popup arm: the Redo opens a window showing B's same live pane (by pane id) while A keeps its own. Head 5/5. The single-popup arm, "undoing a pop-out closes the emptied window within the bound; …", is the direct pop-out/Undo/Redo control under the same bound: head 5/5, 147–167 ms; base 2/2 red at the same assertion. |
| AC-3 | `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsWindows.md`, station five: the Undo paragraph states the rule and that the root's window is never closed. The two-popup retention the ticket calls out of scope is unchanged. |
| AC-4 | Post-merge, per the ticket. A pre-merge full `e2e/workstation` + `e2e/dashboard` run at `5c37424f63`, whose production code this head keeps byte for byte: 228 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed. The failure is `DemoBDockTransactionsNL.spec.mjs:27`: its `save_transaction` returned `archive-store-unavailable` (the Memory Core connection did not settle within 5000 ms). It passed alone right after (1/1). |

## Deltas from ticket
- AC-1's literal sequence (close A natively, then Undo) is red on `e2f77dd0fb` only through #20045. A bare target close goes unrecorded, so the Undo reverts B's pop-out and empties B. With a recorded close, the Undo reverts the return row and re-opens A, which base already did. The red-first therefore runs on the state the unrecorded close produced: two popups, and an Undo that empties B. The literal sequence stays as its own arm, with the close a user makes (`runBeforeUnload`). It first asserts that the close is one history row, then that the Undo re-opens A with its pane, that B keeps its own, and that no open popup is left without a pane. It is green on base and head alike (2/2 and 5/5). Composed with #20053 (`8bc60dff87`), the three arms pass 2/2 each, and so do #20053's four, including its Undo arm over a bare target close.
- `WorkstationNL.spec.mjs:2604` ("pop-out uses the Group cursor to return and replay the same live pane") pinned the retained window: after Undo the popup stayed open without the pane, and Redo reused it. CI's e2e-brain 8/10 went red there at d597c8e98e. At 5c37424f63 the arm waits for the emptied popup to close and for Redo's re-opened window, and still asserts the same live pane instance throughout (3/3 green locally).
- The ticket's fix options were "close it" or "hide it and close it at lease expiry". This PR closes it, through the existing fenced `closeWorkspaceWindow`, and lets redo re-open through the existing `embodyWorkspace`. The redo lands in a new window rather than the same one; AC-2 allows "same or re-opened".

## Test Evidence
- e2e, `WorkstationUndoEmptiedPopupNL.spec.mjs` (three arms, pop-outs through the shared `workstationPopOut` choreography): head ×5, 15/15 green. Merge-base worktree with the spec checked in, ×2: the two emptying arms red 4/4 at "the emptied popup closes", the recorded-close arm green 2/2. Composed with #20053's head `8bc60dff87`, ×2: 6/6 (close 137–179 ms), plus `WorkstationPopupTargetCloseNL.spec.mjs` 8/8.
- Unit, `DockNativeVesselTransaction.spec.mjs`: 34 passed. "an undo that empties a bound popup closes its window, and the redo embodies one again" is red on dev (no close effect). "a replay that leaves a popup its other panes keeps the window, and the root window is never closed" is the policy guard's control.
- Unit, `test/playwright/unit/dashboard` + `test/playwright/unit/manager`: 1561 passed, 2 skipped.
- `npm run check-relative-links`: OK.
